response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), total_and_count AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_telescopes, COUNT(*) as num_statuses FROM status_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.cnt, sc.cnt::NUMERIC / t.total_telescopes as share, 1::NUMERIC / t.num_statuses as avg_share_across_statuses FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_and_count t), above_average AS (SELECT cnt, share, avg_share_across_statuses FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share_across_statuses) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share_across_statuses) as average_excess FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: "Average share across statuses" means the arithmetic mean of all status shares, which equals 1/(count of distinct powerstatus values), treating each status group equally regardless of telescope count.
NULL powerstatus values are treated as a distinct valid status and included in both the numerator (status count) and denominator (total statuses) for the average calculation.
